heading_en: Preliminary Calculation and Approval Before the Application Date for the Internal Ratings-Based Approach
summary_ja: IRB採用予定の最終指定親会社は適用日前から予備計算・承認申請ができ、承認は適用日に行われたものとみなされる。
summary_en: A prospective IRB adopter may start preliminary calculation and apply for approval before the Application Date; approval is deemed given on that date.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that intends to become an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach (meaning an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the foundation internal ratings-based approach prescribed in Article 1, item (xxxiii) of the New Public Notice; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) may, even before the Application Date, in accordance with Article 118 of the New Public Notice, file a notification of the preliminary calculation of the consolidated capital adequacy ratio, preliminarily calculate the consolidated capital adequacy ratio, prepare an interim preliminary calculation report (meaning the interim preliminary calculation report prescribed in that Article) and a preliminary calculation report (meaning the preliminary calculation report prescribed in that Article) and submit them to the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, and, in accordance with Article 117 of the New Public Notice, apply for approval for the use of its internal ratings-based approach.

Where an application has been made pursuant to the preceding paragraph, the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may grant approval, even before the Application Date, in accordance with Article 116 of the New Public Notice. In this case, that approval is deemed to have been granted on the Application Date pursuant to that Article.

The provisions of the preceding two paragraphs apply mutatis mutandis to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that intends to become an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach (meaning an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the advanced internal ratings-based approach prescribed in Article 1, item (xxxiv) of the New Public Notice).
